question: Can a cross-fitted linear split inside the four material attention heads retain temporal transfer while removing same-answer cue/construction variation, with complete attention 15 retained as the already-clean branch?
evidence_boundary: The valid complete-response lattice identifies a target-effective but nonselective five-piece parent. Only the full mask reaches A1 .75; it yields P KL .11881/5 flips and C KL .01156/3 flips. L8H1 is the largest singleton P collision, L9H1 and L11H3 also flip three P rows, and complete attention 15 alone flips no P or C rows. These facts choose the split sites but no projected-subspace outcome has been opened.

population_and_crossfit.rows: The exact 16 A1, 16 A2, 16 aligned P, and 16 aligned C rows from the capability-qualified authority.
population_and_crossfit.folds: Two deterministic group-number parity folds. Every row is patched with projectors fit only on the opposite parity's A1 and P rows.
population_and_crossfit.fit_access: A1 head-response donor-minus-base differences define task directions/spans. Aligned P differences define nuisance spans. A2 and C never fit any projector. Held-parity A1/P rows do not fit their own projector.
population_and_crossfit.positions: Fit response-feature subspaces using every aligned token position through each row's terminal semantic position; apply the same feature projector at every patched position.

fixed_subspaces.dim1: Rank-one oriented difference-in-means direction from opposite-fold A1 response differences.
fixed_subspaces.p_complement_dim1: The same A1 DIM direction after orthogonal projection away from the opposite-fold aligned-P top-eight nuisance span, then renormalization.
fixed_subspaces.task_svd8: Top-eight right singular response-feature directions of opposite-fold A1 differences, with no control fitting.
fixed_subspaces.p_complement_svd8: Top-eight right singular directions of A1 differences after removing the opposite-fold aligned-P top-eight nuisance span.
fixed_subspaces.tolerance: Singular values larger than max singular value times 1e-6 are live; requested rank is capped at eight. No rank is selected from causal outcomes.

causal_arms: each of four task_svd8 head singletons
each of four p_complement_svd8 head singletons
selective_screen_rule: An analytic composed arm passes only if A1 and A2 signed behavioral projection are each >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875, P and C each have zero top-one flips, and max(P median KL, C median KL) <=.02. Pooled controls never select.

predictions.pred_a_authority_crossfit_projectors_clo: All authorities, exact rows/alignment, opposite-parity nonleakage, projector ranks/tolerances, finite metrics, base-self error <=1e-4, and exactly 17 forwards pass.
predictions.pred_b_p_complement_svd8_reduces_aligned: Relative to the complete parent, p_complement_svd8 reduces P median KL by at least 50% and leaves at most one P top-one flip.
predictions.pred_c_p_complement_svd8_preserves_targe: The p_complement_svd8 composition reaches >=.75 signed behavioral projection and >=.875 direction fraction on both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_p_complement_svd8_is_selective: The p_complement_svd8 composition passes the complete selective-screen rule, including independent C.
predictions.pred_e_analytic_rank1_is_sufficient: At least one of dim1 or p_complement_dim1 passes the same selective-screen rule.
predictions.pred_f_control_complement_improves_match: At rank at most eight, p_complement_svd8 has no lower minimum A1/A2 projection than task_svd8 minus .05 and strictly lower P median KL.

terminal_policy.crossfit_p_complement_selective_response: A-D and F pass while E fails.
terminal_policy.crossfit_task_span_selective_without_com: A passes, p_complement_svd8 fails selectivity, and task_svd8 passes selectivity.
terminal_policy.linear_response_split_insufficient: A passes and no analytic composed arm passes selectivity.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: A selective analytic split is a screen requiring fresh-family confirmation and then direct OV/QK/value weight translation. If all linear splits fail, use their held-fold response matrix to define a regularized nonlinear DAS objective with DIM and task_svd8 as explicit baselines; do not tune on A2/C. If complement removes P but destroys target, the P and temporal response subspaces are operationally shared and downstream conditional routing, rather than an orthogonal subspace, is required.
